subject: QBR micro‑lab scheduling + ops delegation
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Perez <alyssa@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR micro‑lab — proposed format and two quick asks

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for locking in a renewal QBR window with us. We want to run a compact, hands‑on micro‑lab this quarter to surface performance wins from the last three months and walk your SREs through the new autoscaling knobs. Proposed approach:

- 45 minutes total, 30m live demo + 15m ops Q&A
- Focus: infer cost profile changes after batching + quick playbook for cold starts
- Deliverable: run_of_show + short checklist your team can run post‑demo

Two asks from our side: can we record the session for internal enablement, and do you want the demo run in a shared test project or in your staging account? If recording is a blocker, we can pare back to a written runbook and a shorter live walkthrough.

I attached a provisional run_of_show (v1) — Marissa, can you confirm backup hosts and who owns the recording flow if Alyssa is OK?

Best,
Kimberly
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: run_of_show_v1.pdf (1 page — agenda + timings)
From: Alyssa Perez <alyssa@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR micro‑lab — proposed format and two quick asks

Kimberly — thanks for the clear proposal. A couple notes from our side:

- 45m sounds good but we need it strictly capped — can you guarantee 30/15 split? Our execs have back‑to‑back commitments.
- Recording: legal requires signed consent for recordings. Can you send a DocuSign for the recording waiver, or point to your standard policy?
- Environment: prefer Redwood to demo in your test project to avoid exposing any of our telemetry. Ops will shadow and validate their checklist afterwards.

If you can send the run‑of‑show and the recording waiver link, I’ll route to legal and confirm by EOD Friday.

—Alyssa
Director, Cloud Platforms, ClearPath Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Perez <alyssa@clearpathhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR micro‑lab — proposed format and two quick asks

Alyssa — appreciate the constraints. We’ll run strict timing. Operational notes:

- I’ll be backup host for the hands‑on section and will keep a visible timer in the demo slides.
- Priyom will own the staging credentials and the test project setup; we’ll sanitize logs before/after the session.
- I attached a slightly tightened run_of_show (v1.1) with explicit timeboxes and a three‑point checklist for your ops team.
- DocuSign: here’s the one‑click recording waiver link — https://docusign.com/sign/ABC-123-CPH-RECORDING (also saved as recording-waiver-docusign-link.txt in this thread).

If legal signs by Friday, we’ll keep the original timebox. If they request no recording, we’ll swap the 15m recording segment for an extended Q&A and mark the session as not recorded.

Kimberly — can you drop the finalized calendar invite once Alyssa confirms?

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: run_of_show_v1.1.pdf (1 page — tightened timings)

Alyssa
